newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shaanxi Trust gains US$10 mln foreign loan.
newsitem.headline: Shaanxi Trust gains US$10 mln foreign loan.

text.p: Shaanxi International Trust and Investment Co Ltd has obtained a US$10 million loan from an overseas banking syndicate, with KEB (Asia) Finance Ltd the agency bank, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The one-year loan, carrying an annual interest of LIBOR plus 0.75 percentage points, will be used to supplement working capital, the spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
He said that Shaanxi Trust would lend the money for infrastructure projects in northwestern Shaanxi province.
